abstract: STUDY OBJECTIVE: To compare the rates of oophorectomy performed by pediatric surgeons for benign indications before and after the addition of a gynecologist to the surgical staff of a children's hospital. DESIGN, SETTING, PARTICIPANTS, INTERVENTIONS, AND MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: We used a retrospective chart review of patients ages 5-21 years who underwent surgical management by pediatric surgeons for benign adnexal indications at a tertiary care children's hospital. Patient characteristics and clinical outcomes were recorded. Rates of oophorectomy for patients managed before the addition of a gynecologist (1998-2004) were compared with those managed after a gynecologist joined the surgical staff (2005-2013). Logistic regression analysis was conducted to compare the likelihood of oophorectomy before and after the addition of a gynecologist to the surgical staff. RESULTS: One hundred sixty-five cases were included in the final analysis. Pediatric surgeons were 8 times more likely to perform an oophorectomy for benign indications before the addition of a gynecologist to the surgical staff (odds ratio, 8.3; 95% confidence interval, 3.76-18.16). Oophorectomy was performed in 45% (25/56) of cases from 1998 to 2004 compared with 11% (12/109) of cases from 2005 to 2013. Younger age (P = .009), ischemic-appearing adnexa (P < .0001), presence of torsion (P = .017), and mature teratoma (P = .041) were associated with higher likelihood of oophorectomy. CONCLUSION: There was a higher rate of ovarian preservation for benign indications performed by pediatric surgeons after the addition of a gynecologist to the surgical staff. Younger patients, those with a mature teratoma, and ovarian torsion continue to be at higher risk for oophorectomy.
abstract_ja: 研究目的:小児病院の外科スタッフに婦人科医が加わる前後で、小児外科医が良性適応で行った卵巣摘出術の割合を比較すること。デザイン、設定、対象者、介入、主要評価項目:三次医療を担う小児病院で、良性付属器疾患に対して小児外科医による外科的管理を受けた5~21歳の患者について、後方視的診療録レビューを用いた。患者特性および臨床転帰を記録した。婦人科医が外科スタッフに加わる前(1998~2004年)に管理された患者の卵巣摘出術の割合を、婦人科医が加わった後(2005~2013年)と比較した。ロジスティック回帰分析により、婦人科医の外科スタッフへの加入前後での卵巣摘出術の可能性を比較した。結果:最終解析に165例が含まれた。婦人科医が外科スタッフに加わる前には、小児外科医が良性適応で卵巣摘出術を行う可能性が8倍高かった(オッズ比8.3、95%信頼区間3.76~18.16)。卵巣摘出術は、1998~2004年の症例では45%(25/56)で行われていたのに対し、2005~2013年の症例では11%(12/109)であった。若年齢(P = .009)、虚血性外観の付属器(P < .0001)、捻転の存在(P = .017)、および成熟奇形腫(P = .041)が、卵巣摘出術の可能性の上昇と関連していた。結論:婦人科医が外科スタッフに加わった後、小児外科医が良性適応で行う卵巣温存の割合が高くなった。若年患者、成熟奇形腫を有する患者、および卵巣捻転は、引き続き卵巣摘出術のリスクが高い。
